scope.method: Enumerate tracked curriculum packages, source imports, media, known embedded-content modules, curriculum regression fixtures, and curriculum reference documents; record path, classification, source/evidence links where supported, canonical size, digest mode, and SHA-256 only. No source corpus is downloaded.
limitations: Path and digest inventory does not detect paraphrase, copying, embedded data, or authorship.
A source link or public availability is not a reuse grant.
RIGHTS_UNCLEAR is blocked for publishable artifacts; it is not a legal finding.
An empty THIRD_PARTY_RESTRICTED set would not prove the tree contains no such material.
A file-level inventory is a coverage gate, not an item-by-item source comparison or legal decision; its hashes detect drift but do not establish authorship or license terms.

Curriculum-bearing code, regression fixtures, and reference documents are tracked because they are public repository text, but their inclusion does not make them publishable lessons or rights-cleared content.
